title: 听力挑战 · 答辩演练

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: In my thesis, I argue that the policy that was implemented last year has failed to achieve its goals.
rounds.lineCn: 在论文中,我论证去年实施的那项政策未能实现其目标。

grammar.name: 宾语从句嵌套定语从句
grammar.note: argue that 引导宾语从句,其中 the policy that was implemented 又嵌套定语从句,是典型真题长难句结构。

options.text: The thesis argues that the policy failed to reach its goals.
options.feedback: 论文的核心观点是政策没有实现目标。

options.text: The thesis fully supports the policy's achievements.
options.feedback: 论文论证的是政策失败,而非支持它。

options.text: The thesis never mentions the policy at all.
options.feedback: 政策正是论文论证的主要对象。

rounds.speaker: 答辩委员
rounds.line: Could you explain the method that you used to collect the data and why it was appropriate?
rounds.lineCn: 你能解释一下你收集数据所用的方法,以及它为什么合适吗?

grammar.name: 并列疑问 + 定语从句
grammar.note: the method that you used 是定语从句;why it was appropriate 与前面并列,要求既说方法又讲理由。

options.text: The committee asks about the data collection method and its suitability.
options.feedback: 委员会要求说明方法并解释其合理性。

options.text: The committee asks about the thesis title only.
options.feedback: 问题针对数据收集方法,与题目无关。

options.text: The committee asks about the conclusion only.
options.feedback: 问题涉及方法及其适用性,不是结论。

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: Although the sample size was small, the results were consistent, which strengthens our confidence in the findings.
rounds.lineCn: 虽然样本量较小,但结果一致,这增强了我们对发现的信心。

grammar.name: 让步从句 + 非限制性定语从句
grammar.note: Although 让步(样本小)与主句(结果一致)对比;which 指代整个主句内容,是长难句高频结构。

options.text: Consistent results despite a small sample increase confidence.
options.feedback: 样本虽小但结果一致,增强了研究信心。

options.text: The small sample makes all the findings unreliable.
options.feedback: 结果一致反而增强了信心,原文并非否定。

options.text: The results were inconsistent across the samples.
options.feedback: 原文明确说结果是一致的。

rounds.speaker: 答辩委员
rounds.line: What further research do you recommend, and how would it address the limitations of this study?
rounds.lineCn: 你建议开展哪些后续研究?它又将如何弥补本研究的不足?

grammar.name: 并列特殊疑问句
grammar.note: 两个疑问句并列:what 问研究建议,how 问弥补方式;it 指代后续研究,注意指代关系。

options.text: The committee asks about future research and the study's limitations.
options.feedback: 委员会问的是后续研究建议及其如何弥补局限。

options.text: The committee asks about the publication date of the paper.
The committee thinks the study has no limitations.
options.feedback: 问题本身默认研究存在局限,需要弥补。
